title: Open edX Stack Variables
description: Variables for Open edX LMS and Studio/CMS stack deployment with full Tutor and edx-platform parameter parity.

OPENEDX_INSTALL_MODE.description: Deployment mode for the Open edX installation (minimal, production, dev, or offline).

OPENEDX_RELEASE.description: Open edX release branch or tag to install (e.g., release/verawood.1, release/verawood, master).

OPENEDX_GIT_REPO.description: Git repository URL for cloning or updating the openedx-platform source code.

PLATFORM_NAME.description: Public display name of the Open edX learning platform.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Public contact and support email address for the Open edX platform.

LANGUAGE_CODE.description: Default ISO 639-1 language code for the Open edX platform.

LMS_HOST.description: Domain name or hostname for the LMS (Learning Management System).

CMS_HOST.description: Domain name or hostname for Studio/CMS.

PREVIEW_LMS_HOST.description: Domain name or hostname for course preview mode in the LMS.

MFE_HOST.description: Domain name or hostname serving Micro-Frontend (MFE) single-page applications.

LMS_PORT.description: HTTP port for the LMS application server.

CMS_PORT.description: HTTP port for the Studio/CMS application server.

CADDY_HTTP_PORT.description: HTTP port bound by the Caddy reverse proxy.

ENABLE_HTTPS.description: Whether to enable HTTPS / TLS termination on public Open edX URLs.

ENABLE_WEB_PROXY.description: Whether Caddy should act as the primary reverse proxy and TLS terminator.

ENABLE_CORS_CREDENTIALS.description: Whether cross-origin requests with credentials are permitted across LMS, Studio, and MFE domains.

CORS_ORIGIN_WHITELIST.description: List of additional origin URLs allowed to perform cross-origin requests against LMS and CMS.

RUN_LMS.description: Whether to run the LMS web application service locally.

RUN_CMS.description: Whether to run the Studio/CMS web application service locally.

RUN_LMS_WORKER.description: Whether to run the LMS Celery background worker locally.

RUN_CMS_WORKER.description: Whether to run the Studio/CMS Celery background worker locally.

RUN_CADDY.description: Whether to run the local Caddy web proxy service.

RUN_MYSQL.description: Whether to provision and run a local MySQL database instance.

RUN_MONGODB.description: Whether to provision and run a local MongoDB database instance.

RUN_REDIS.description: Whether to provision and run a local Redis cache and message broker instance.

RUN_MEILISEARCH.description: Whether to provision and run a local Meilisearch search engine instance.

RUN_SMTP.description: Whether to provision and run a local SMTP mail transfer agent.

RUN_MINIO.description: Whether to provision and run a local MinIO S3-compatible object storage service.

RUN_MFE.description: Whether to build and serve Micro-Frontend (MFE) applications.

MYSQL_HOST.description: Hostname or IP address of the MySQL database server.

MYSQL_PORT.description: TCP port of the MySQL database server.

MYSQL_ROOT_USERNAME.description: Administrative root username for MySQL database provisioning.

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Administrative root password for MySQL database provisioning.

OPENEDX_MYSQL_DATABASE.description: Name of the MySQL database schema used by Open edX.

OPENEDX_MYSQL_USERNAME.description: MySQL application username for Open edX.

OPENEDX_MYSQL_PASSWORD.description: MySQL application password for Open edX.

MONGODB_HOST.description: Hostname or SRV connection string of the MongoDB server.

MONGODB_PORT.description: TCP port of the MongoDB server.

MONGODB_USERNAME.description: MongoDB authentication username for Open edX modulestore.

MONGODB_PASSWORD.description: MongoDB authentication password for Open edX modulestore.

MONGODB_DATABASE.description: Name of the MongoDB database used for course modulestore.

REDIS_HOST.description: Hostname or IP address of the Redis server.

REDIS_PORT.description: TCP port of the Redis server.

REDIS_USERNAME.description: Optional ACL username for authenticating with Redis.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Optional password for authenticating with Redis.

REDIS_DATABASE.description: Redis logical database index used by Open edX cache and Celery.

MEILISEARCH_HOST.description: Public hostname for the Meilisearch search service.

MEILISEARCH_PORT.description: TCP port for the Meilisearch search service.

MEILISEARCH_API_KEY.description: Master API key used to authenticate against Meilisearch.

MEILISEARCH_URL.description: Internal URL used by LMS and Studio to connect to Meilisearch.

MEILISEARCH_PUBLIC_URL.description: Publicly accessible URL for Meilisearch queries from browser clients.

MINIO_HOST.description: Hostname for MinIO S3-compatible object storage.

MINIO_PORT.description: TCP port for MinIO S3 API.

MINIO_ACCESS_KEY.description: Access key ID for MinIO or S3 storage.

MINIO_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret access key for MinIO or S3 storage.

OPENEDX_AWS_S3_STORAGE.description: Whether to store media, staticgrades, and course exports on S3/MinIO object storage.

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname for outbound transactional emails.

SMTP_PORT.description: SMTP server port for outbound transactional emails.

SMTP_USERNAME.description: Username for authenticating with the outbound SMTP server.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: Password for authenticating with the outbound SMTP server.

SMTP_USE_TLS.description: Whether to use STARTTLS when connecting to the SMTP server.

SMTP_USE_SSL.description: Whether to use implicit SSL/TLS when connecting to the SMTP server.

OPENEDX_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Default superuser username created during platform initialization.

OPENEDX_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Default superuser email address created during platform initialization.

OPENEDX_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Default superuser password created during platform initialization.

OPENEDX_SECRET_KEY.description: Cryptographic secret key used by Django for signing sessions and tokens.

JWT_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY.description: PEM-encoded RSA private key used to sign Open edX JWT authentication tokens.

CMS_OAUTH2_KEY.description: Internal OAuth2 client key used by Studio to communicate with LMS.

CMS_OAUTH2_SECRET.description: OAuth2 client secret shared between LMS and Studio.

CMS_OAUTH2_KEY_SSO.description: Production OAuth2 client key for browser single sign-on (SSO) into Studio.

CMS_OAUTH2_KEY_DEV.description: Development OAuth2 client key for Studio.

CMS_OAUTH2_KEY_SSO_DEV.description: Development OAuth2 client key for browser single sign-on (SSO) into Studio.

OPENEDX_LMS_UWSGI_WORKERS.description: Number of Gunicorn / WSGI worker processes for the LMS service.

OPENEDX_CMS_UWSGI_WORKERS.description: Number of Gunicorn / WSGI worker processes for the Studio/CMS service.

LMS_CELERY_WORKERS.description: Concurrency level for LMS Celery background workers.

CMS_CELERY_WORKERS.description: Concurrency level for Studio/CMS Celery background workers.

CELERY_BROKER_KIND.description: Message broker backend used for Celery asynchronous task queues.

OPENEDX_THEME.description: Active comprehensive theme applied to LMS and Studio (e.g., indigo, default).

items.description: Python package specification or Git URL for pip installation.

OPENEDX_EXTRA_PIP_REQUIREMENTS.description: Additional Python packages and XBlocks to install into the Open edX virtual environment.

items.description: Name of enabled Tutor-compatible Open edX plugin.
URL of a Tutor plugin index.

PLUGIN_INDEXES.description: Remote plugin index URLs for discovering and installing Open edX plugins.

items.description: Mount specification in the form /host/path or service:/host/path:/target/path.

MOUNTS.description: Local host directory bind mounts linked into the Open edX application and MFE paths.

PATCHES.description: Dictionary mapping Tutor patch slot names (e.g., openedx-common-settings, lms-env, caddyfile) to custom snippet strings.

additionalProperties.description: Custom configuration or Python settings snippet injected into the named patch slot.
